references.text: Moses had previously announced that on the sixth day they should gather twice as much bread, which is now fulfilled in verse 22.
Moses explains the reason for the double portion: the seventh day is the Sabbath, a holy rest day for the Lord.
The Lord gives the people a double portion on the sixth day so that they may rest on the seventh day, the Sabbath.
The Sabbath commandment in the Ten Commandments, which explains why the sixth day required preparation through double gathering.
The Sabbath as a holy rest day, which is the reason the people had to gather twice as much on the sixth day.
The leaders (נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה) in Israel who came to Moses correspond to the seventy elders who were appointed.
The book of Hebrews refers to God's rest on the seventh day, which is the basis for the Sabbath rest that led to double gathering on the sixth day.
The original instruction about daily gathering (v.4) clarifies the specific double gathering on the sixth day (16:22).
The sixth day as a time of preparation before rest (Sabbath) links the creation order with the law given in the wilderness.
